name: Working Days
source:
Main character discovers that his body is transparent one day. In order to return his normal body he consults different offices and takes various bodyguard, spy and security jobs.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，主人公发现自己的身体变得透明。为了恢复原状，他前往不同办事机构寻求帮助，并接下各种保镖、间谍与安保工作。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
